blocks.title: FCFS
blocks.text: First come, first served: non-preemptive queue in arrival order.

blocks.title: SJF
blocks.text: Shortest job first: choose least burst time from ready jobs; non-preemptive.

blocks.title: SRT
blocks.text: Shortest remaining time: preempt if a new job has a shorter remaining burst.
